answer: My answer to sybils is Signed witness statement record with court attestation — statements the court recorded across cases over years — which makes the echo of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Honest agents barely notice the check, because statements the court recorded across cases over years is something they already have; the vertex falls entirely on the farm, which must buy or steal it a hundred times. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the knoll of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head.
